about: The five third-party skills under .agents/skills, as last read by someone. skills-lock.json says where each came from; this file pins what was actually read. tests/test_vendored_skills.py fails when a skill's files change, gain a non-Markdown file, or appear/disappear without this file changing in the same commit. To accept an update: read the diff (git diff -- .agents/skills/<name>), then replace sha256/files here and the reviewed date. OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10 (2026-08-17): AST02 supply chain, AST07 update drift.

angular-developer.note: Markdown only. No commands that fetch or run remote code.

db.note: Markdown only. One local edit since install: 3af21d6 replaced a sample JWT in ords/ords-authentication.md with NOT_A_REAL_ACCESS_TOKEN so the secret scanner stops flagging it. 'Proceed without asking' appears only for read-only steps (EXPLAIN PLAN, schema introspection).
